implementation.detail: Tested 42b8e6ca07ca5d3be1de1241a92f30a8d1b1cf01, correcting the review of attempt-001. Trace schema is splot.mtp.trace.v2. Each phase_end now carries explicit model_calls; the reducer exposes model_calls_by_phase and phase_occurrences_by_phase separately, and role totals use actual runner calls. shallow_draft model_calls equals actual scratch advances (D1 0/1/>1, D2 0); every other phase is one call. decode_seconds is run_end-prefill_end and includes the complete first generation round; TTFT, post_first_commit_seconds, first_round_committed_tokens and tokens_after_first_commit are separate. committed_tokens_per_decode_second uses all committed tokens over decode time. Observer=None still preserves tokens, RNG, calls, Result and caches. No model equation, sampling, data, harness, CI or FP8 change.

limitations: Local Mac has no torch module; the 16 torch integration tests were executed only on hosted CPU, and no local integration pass is claimed.
Synthetic fixture timings use an injected fake clock and are not throughput or latency measurements.
Observer callback overhead was not measured; the future benchmark must pair observer-off/on and synchronize device work outside callbacks.
D0 stochastic output is not expected to match D1/D2 token sequences because RNG consumption differs; only greedy equality is claimed.
The benchmark document is a protocol only. No trained-checkpoint speed, memory, acceptance-rate or quality result is reported.
The observer is exact-reference instrumentation, not a production cache manager or fused kernel.
Attempt-001 remains historical review-rejected evidence; only attempt-002 carries the correction.
